contradictions_and_tensions: CONTRIBUTING DoD requires "actual review is complete" and "relevant PR is merged"; GOVERNANCE says there is one maintainer and no other reviewers or approvers. The policy does not say how a maintainer-authored PR is reviewed, so Done cannot be reached independently.

CONTRIBUTING ## Review and GOVERNANCE ## Review roles require security/realtime-canvas/data/platform expertise routing; CODEOWNERS routes everything (*) to @CompleteDotTech only. Expertise routing is documentation-only.
SECURITY.md Release gates require "actual independent security review"; no independent reviewer exists anywhere in the repo.
Acceptance clause 6 (no Discord/GoDaddy pass from mocks) is documented in CONTRIBUTING but unenforced by tests.

CODE_OF_CONDUCT and GOVERNANCE both route conduct reports to a private path that depends on a published GitHub profile contact; if none is published, the reporter is asked to request a channel. No channel is defined.

No contradictions found between GOVERNANCE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, SECURITY.md, CODEOWNERS and the issue templates on the handle (@CompleteDotTech everywhere) or on assignees (no template assigns).

defects.summary: The acceptance command `python3 -I -B -m unittest tests.verification.test_governance_policy -v` exits 1 with ImportError: under -I the cwd is not on sys.path. The governance test was run with discover instead (63 OK). The T0 record documents `python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/verification -v`.
Legacy single-file .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md with assignees is not scanned; load_templates only reads the ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ directory.
`assign:` key in a template passes; ASSIGNEES_KEY_RE and ASSIGN_HINT_RE only match assignee(s)/auto-assign.
Negated visibility sentences pass: "assigned issues are not visible in the live Project backlog" and "unassigned issues are not visible as unassigned" satisfy the property regexes.
"Unassigned issues are deleted after 30 days" passes; forbidden list has archive/removed from/hidden but not deleted/closed/purged.
SLA phrasings without digits or the word SLA pass ("within two business days", "given in 2 days").
A public issue-thread channel for conduct reports added alongside the private sentence passes.
A named reviewer without an @handle ("Reviewer of record: Alice Smith") passes the identity check, which matches only @-tokens and emails.
Removing the Discord/GoDaddy mocked-checks sentence from CONTRIBUTING passes; clause 6 has no enforcing test.
The semantically equivalent "Assignment does not hide backlog" is rejected because the check requires the word "never".
